# ADR-3269: AWS backups: Prefer restore-test drills for backup plan 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Untested backups fail during incidents.

## Decision

Ops SHOULD prefer restore-test drills for backup plan 5 (AWS-backups-5) when validating recoverability.

## Consequences

Drill results are recorded as evidence.
